title: Ziyarat of the Holy Prophet (saw)
description: Comprehensive Ziyarat of the Holy Prophet (saw) including shrine visitation, distance recitation, and special salutations.

lines.english: Visiting the Shrine of the Holy Prophet (saw)
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Abdullah.
Peace be upon you, O Seal of the Prophets.
I bear witness that you conveyed the Mission,
performed the prayers,
gave alms,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,

lines.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱليَقِينُ
lines.english: and served Almighty Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
lines.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu

lines.english: Blessings and mercy of Allah be upon you
and upon your Household, the Immaculate.

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
lines.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, One and Only and having no associate,
lines.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu

lines.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu

lines.english: I bear witness that you are the messenger of Allah
and you are Muhammad the son of `Abdullah.

lines.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالاَتِ رَبِّكَ
lines.english: I bear witness that you have conveyed the messages of your Lord,
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka qad ballaghta risalati rabbika

lines.english: offered your people good advice,
striven hard in the way of Allah,
worshipped Allah -until death came upon you-
with wisdom and fair exhortation,
fulfilled the duty that was incumbent upon you,
acted compassionately to the believers,
and been firm of heart against the unbelievers.

lines.arabic: فَبَلَّغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ افْضَلَ شَرَفِ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
lines.english: Therefore, Almighty Allah has exalted you to the most honorable position of the ennobled ones.
lines.transliteration: faballgha allahu bika afdala sharafi mahalli almukarramina

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَنْقَذَنَا بِكَ مِنْ ٱلشِّرْكِ وَٱلضَّلالَةِ
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has saved us, through you, from polytheism and error.
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi istanqadhana bika min alshshirki walddalalati

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَٱجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَصَلَوَاتِ مَلائِكَتِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) pour Your blessings and the blessings of Your Archangels,
lines.transliteration: allahumma faj`al salawatika wa salawati mala'ikatika almuqarrabina

lines.english: Your commissioned Prophets,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ ٱلعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: and all those who glorified You, O Lord of the Worlds,
lines.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina

lines.english: from the past and the coming generations,
on Muhammad—Your servant, Your Messenger,
Your Prophet, Your Trustee,
Your Confidant, Your Most Beloved,
Your Choice, Your Select,
Your elite, and the best of Your creation.
lines.transliteration: wa safwatika wa khiyaratika min khalqika

lines.english: O Allah, (please do) confer upon him with the Elevated Rank,
grant him the right of intercession for entering Paradise,

lines.arabic: وَٱبْعَثْهُ مَقَاماً مَحْمُوداً يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ ٱلاوَّلُونَ وَٱلآخِرُونَ
lines.english: and raise him to a Position of Glory that all the past and the coming generations will wish to have.
lines.transliteration: wab`athhu maqaman mahmudan yaghbituhu bihi al-awwaluna wal-akhiruna

lines.english: O Allah, You have said,

lines.arabic: «وَلَوْ انَّهُمْ إِذْ ظَلَمُوا انْفُسَهُمْ جَاؤُوكَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوٱ ٱللَّهَ
lines.english: “And had they, when they were unjust to themselves, come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah
lines.transliteration: walaw annahum idh zalamu anfusahum ja'uka fastaghfaru allaha

lines.english: and the Messenger had (also) asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning (to mercy), Merciful.”

lines.arabic: وَإِنِّي اتَيْتُكَ مُسْتَغْفِراً تَائِباً مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
lines.english: Here I am, before you, asking Allah’s forgiveness, repenting from my sins,
lines.transliteration: wa inni ataytuka mustaghfiran ta'iban min dhunubi

lines.arabic: وَإِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكَ لِيَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي
lines.english: and seeking your intercession for me before Almighty Allah—your and my Lord—that He may forgive my sins.
lines.transliteration: wa inni atawajjahu bika ila allahi rabbi wa rabbika liyaghfira li dhunubi

lines.english: I pray Allah -Who has chosen you, selected you,
guided you, and guided (others) through you-
to bless You.
“Surely, Allah and His angels bless the Prophet;
lines.transliteration: inna allaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna `ala alnnabiyyi

lines.arabic: يَا ايُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٱ صَلُّوٱ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوٱ تَسْلِيماً.»
lines.english: O you who believe! Call for (Divine) blessings on him and salute him with a (becoming) salutation.”
lines.transliteration: ya ayyuha alladhina amanu sallu `alayhi wa sallumu tasliman

lines.english: I beseech You, O All-magnanimous,
O All-generous,
O Nigh,
O Remote,
to renew Your boons to me.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللَّهَ وَ أَسْتَرْعِيكَ وَ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمَ‏ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَ بِمَا جِئْتَ بِهِ وَ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ‏ فَإِنْ تَوَفَّيْتَنِي قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ فِي مَمَاتِي عَلَى مَا شَهِدْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ‏ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ‏ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ لاَ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ آخِرَ تَسْلِيمِي عَلَيْك
lines.english: Peace be on you, O Apostle of Allah I entrust you with Allah, I request Him to take care of I say “peace be on you”… I believe in Allah, and in that which you brought, and in that to which you guided. O Allah let not my this visitation to the grave of Your Prophet be my last. If You cause me to die before I come here again, then I, bear witness in my death upon what I testify in my lifetime, that there is no god save You, and that Mohammad is Your bondman and Your Apostle, blessing of Allah be on him and his progeny..
lines.transliteration: assalaamo a’layka yaa rasoolallaahe.. astawde-o’kallaaha wa astar-e’eka wa aqra-o a’laykas salaama aamanto billaahe wa bemaa jea-ta behi wa dalalta a’layhe allaahumma laa taj-a’lho aakheral a’hde minnee le zeyaarate qabre nabiyyeka fa-in tawaffaytanee qabla zaalekafa-innee ash-hado fee mamaatee a’laa maa shahidto a’layhe fee hayaatee an laa elaaha illaa anta wa anna mohammadan a’bdoka wa rasooloka sallallaaho a’layhe wa aalehi ..

lines.english: Seventeenth of Rabi` al-Awwal

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
lines.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah, alone without having any associate,
lines.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu

lines.english: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger,
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu

lines.english: that he is the chief of the ancient and the coming generations,
and that he is the chief of all Prophets and Messengers.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ ٱلائِمَةِ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon him and upon his Household—the Immaculate Imams.
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `alayhi wa `ala ahli baytihi al-a'immati alttayyibina

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Friend of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Choice of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Mercy of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Well-Chosen by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Most Beloved by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Selected by Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O Master of the Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O Maintainer of justice.
Peace be upon you, O introducer of goodliness.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَعْدِنَ ٱلوَحْيِ وَٱلتَّنْزِيلِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O core of Divine Inspiration and Revelation.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُبَلِّغاً عَنِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O conveyor on behalf of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O light-giving torch.
Peace be upon you, O conveyor of good tidings (to the believers).
Peace be upon you, O warner (against Allah’s chastisement).
Peace be upon you, O he who warns (against violating Allah’s commands).

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُسْتَضَاءُ بِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Light that spreads luminosity.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi alladhi yustada'u bihi

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon your Household—the pure, immaculate,
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa `ala ahli baytika alttayyibina alttahirina

lines.english: guides, and rightly guided.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ جَدِّكَ عَبْدِ ٱلْمُطَّلِبِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you and upon your grandfather, `Abd al-Muttalib,
and upon your father, `Abdullah.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ امِّكَ آمِنَةَ بِنْتِ وَهَبٍ
lines.english: peace be upon your mother, ªminah the daughter of Wahab.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ حَمْزَةَ سَيِّدِ ٱلشُّهَدَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be upon your (paternal) uncle, Hamzah, the master of martyrs.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ ٱلعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْمُطَّلِبِ
lines.english: Peace be upon your uncle, al-`Abbas the son of `Abd al-Muttalib.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ عَمِّكَ وَكَفِيلِكَ ابِي طَالِبٍ
lines.english: Peace be upon your uncle and your guardian, Abu-Talib.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱبْنِ عَمِّكَ جَعْفَرٍ ٱلطَّيَّارِ فِي جِنَانِ ٱلْخُلْدِ
lines.english: Peace be upon your cousin, Ja`far the flying in the gardens of the Paradise of Eternity.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `ala ibni `ammika ja`farin alttayyari fi jinani alkhuldi

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad (the praised).
Peace be upon you, O Ahmad (the more praised).

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Argument of Allah against the past and coming generations,
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi `ala al-awwalina wal-akhirina

lines.english: foremost to the obedience to the Lord of the worlds,
prevailing over His Messengers,
last of His Prophets,
witness over all His creatures,
interceder to Him,
firmly established with Him,
obeyed in His Kingdom,
winner of the most praised qualities,
holder of the most praised honors,
honored by the Lord,
addressee (by Almighty Allah) from behind the (Divine) Veils,
most advanced in position,
and unovertakable.
I greet you with the greeting of him who acknowledges your right (that is incumbent upon us),
who confesses of his shortcoming in carrying out his duty towards you,

lines.arabic: غَيْرِ مُنْكِرٍ مَا ٱنْتَهَىٰ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
lines.english: who does not discuss your limitless virtues,
lines.transliteration: ghayri munkirin ma intaha ilayhi min fadlika

lines.english: who is sure that you will have more rewards from your Lord,
who believes in the Book that was revealed to you,
who deems lawful all that which you deemed lawful,
and who deems unlawful all that which you deemed unlawful.

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ مَعَ كُلِّ شَاهِدٍ
lines.english: O Messenger of Allah, I bear witness—and I join everyone who bears witness
lines.transliteration: ashhadu ya rasula allahi ma`a kulli shahidin

lines.english: and also bear witness rather than everyone who may deny it—
that you conveyed the messages of your Lord (flawlessly),
offered your nation good advice,
strove in the way of your Lord,
expounded openly what you were commanded to convey,
stood harm for the sake of Him,

lines.arabic: وَدَعَوْتَ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلْجَمِيلَةِ
lines.english: called to the way of Him with excellent wisdom and fair exhortation,
lines.transliteration: wa da`awta ila sabilihi bilhikmati walmaw`izati alhasanati aljamilati

lines.english: fulfilled the duty with which you were commissioned,
you, verily, were compassionate to the believers,
strong against the unbelievers,

lines.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱليَقِينُ
lines.english: and you worshipped Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
lines.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu

lines.arabic: فَبَلَغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ اشْرَفَ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
lines.english: Therefore, Almighty Allah has exalted you to the most honorable position of the ennobled ones,
lines.transliteration: fabalagha allahu bika ashrafa mahalli almukarramina

lines.english: to the most elevated place of the intimate servants of Him,

lines.arabic: وَارْفَعَ دَرَجَاتِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ حَيْثُ لاَ يَلْحَقُكَ لاَحِقٌ
lines.english: and to the most exalted ranks of the Messengers where none can come up with you,
lines.transliteration: wa arfa`a darajati almursalina haythu la yalhaquka lahiqun

lines.english: none can excel you,
none can overtake you,
and none can even think of obtaining your rank.
lines.transliteration: wa la yatma`u fi idrakika tami`un

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَنْقَذَنَا بِكَ مِنَ ٱلْهَلَكَةِ
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who saved us from perdition through you,
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi istanqadhana bika min alhalakati

lines.english: Who guided us off misdirection through you,
and Who lit our darkness through you.

lines.arabic: فَجَزَاكَ ٱللَّهُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ مَبْعُوثٍ افْضَلَ مَا جَازَىٰ نَبِيّاً عَنْ امَّتِهِ
lines.english: O Messenger of Allah, may Allah reward you, for you are His envoy, with the best rewarding that He has ever conferred upon a prophet on behalf of his people
lines.transliteration: fajazaka allahu ya rasula allahi min mab`uthin afdala ma jaza nabiyyan `an ummatihi

lines.english: or a messenger on behalf of those to whom He has sent him.

lines.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ زُرْتُكَ عَارِفاً بِحَقِّكَ
lines.english: May Allah accept my father and my mother as ransoms for you, O Messenger of Allah. I am visiting you for I acknowledge your right (that is incumbent upon us),
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya rasula allahi zurtuka `arifan bihaqqika

lines.english: I confess of your superiority,

lines.arabic: مُسْتَبْصِراً بِضَلالَةِ مَنْ خَالَفَكَ وَخَالَفَ اهْلَ بَيْتِكَ
lines.english: I know for sure about the straying off (from the right path) of those who dissent from you and from your Household,
lines.transliteration: mustabsiran bidalalati man khalafaka wa khalafa ahla baytika

lines.english: and I admit the true guidance that you follow (and lead to).

lines.arabic: بِابِي انْتَ وَامِّي وَنَفْسِي وَاهْلِي وَمَالِي وَوَلَدِي
lines.english: May Allah accept my father, my mother, me, my family, my property, and my sons as ransoms for you!
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi wa nafsi wa ahli wa mali wa waladi

lines.arabic: انَا اصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ كَمَا صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ
lines.english: Let me invoke Almighty Allah’s blessings upon you in the same way as Allah did send blessings upon you
and so did His angels, Prophets, and Messengers;
lines.transliteration: wa salla `alayka mala'ikatuhu wa anbiya'uhu wa rusuluhu

lines.english: such blessings that are consecutive, abundant,

lines.arabic: لاَ ٱنْقِطَاعَ لَهَا وَلاَ امَدَ وَلاَ اجَلَ
lines.english: continuous, incessant, infinite, and unlimited.
lines.transliteration: la inqita`a laha wa la amada wa la ajala

lines.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ كَمَا انْتُمْ اهْلُهُ
lines.english: May Allah send blessings upon you and upon your Household, the pure and immaculate, as much as you deserve.
lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayka wa `ala ahli baytika alttayyibina alttahirina kama antum ahluhu

lines.english: O Allah, (please do) make You complete blessings,
Your perfect benedictions,
Your most virtuous boons,
and Your most honorable greetings, salutations,
dignities, and mercy,
as well as the blessings of Your archangels,
your commissioned Prophets,
Your elite Imams,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ ٱلعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: and (the blessings of) everyone who glorified You, O Lord of the worlds,
lines.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina

lines.english: from the past and the coming generations—
make all these pour forth upon Muhammad; Your servant, Your messenger,
Your witness, Your Prophet,
Your warner, Your trustee,
Your firmly established (in truth), Your confidante,
Your elite, Your most beloved,
Your friend, Your choice,
Your notable, Your elect,
Your well-chosen, Your mercy,
the best of Your created beings,
the Prophet of mercy,
the storer of forgiveness,
the leader to goodliness and blessing,
the savior of the servants (of Almighty Allah) from perdition by Your permission,
lines.transliteration: wa munqidhi al`ibadi mina alhalakati bi'idhnika

lines.english: the caller of them to Your religion,
the custodian by Your order,
the first Prophet to make the covenant,
and the last Prophet to be sent (to humanity),
whom You have immersed in the ocean of virtue,
in the lofty rank,
in the elevated level,
and in the exalted position;
and whom You entrusted in the pure loins
and moved to the immaculate wombs
lines.transliteration: wa naqaltahu minha ila al-arhami almutahharati

lines.english: out of Your kindness to him
and Your compassion to him.
In order to safeguard, to shield,
to protect, and to defend him,
You assigned, out of Your omnipotence, a protective lookout over him
to keep him from the impurities of adultery
and from the defects of fornication;
thus, You raised the sights of the servants through him
and revived the derelict lands

lines.arabic: بِانْ كَشَفْتَ عَنْ نُورِ وِلادَتِهِ ظُلَمَ ٱلاسْتَارِ
lines.english: when You removed the screening murk by the light of his birth
lines.transliteration: bi'an kashafta `an nuri wiladatihi zulama al-astari

lines.english: and dressed Your Holy Precinct the garments of brightness through him.
lines.transliteration: wa albasta haramaka bihi hulala al-anwari

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا خَصَصْتَهُ بِشرَفِ هٰذِهِ ٱلْمَرْتَبَةِ ٱلكَرِيمَةِ
lines.english: O Allah, as You have given him exclusively the honor of this noble rank
lines.transliteration: allahumma fakama khasastahu bishrafi hadhihi almartabati alkarimati

lines.english: and the privilege of this great merit,
(please do) bless him for he fulfilled his covenant to You,
conveyed all Your messages,
fought against the infidels in order to prove Your Oneness,

lines.arabic: وَقَطَعَ رَحِمَ ٱلكُفْرِ فِي إِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ
lines.english: exterminated the womb of atheism in order to strengthen Your religion,
lines.transliteration: wa qata`a rahima alkufri fi i`zazi dinika

lines.arabic: وَلَبِسَ ثَوْبَ ٱلبَلْوَىٰ فِي مُجَاهَدَةِ اعْدَائِكَ
lines.english: and dressed himself the garb of misfortune in order to struggle against Your enemies.
lines.transliteration: wa labisa thawba albalwa fi mujahadati a`da'ika

lines.english: Hence, You have given him as recompense for any harm that inflicted him,
lines.transliteration: wa awjabta lahu bikulli adhan massahu

lines.english: any trickery that he faced
from the faction who tried to assassinate him;
a merit that excels all other merits
and due to which he possessed Your abundant gifts.
lines.transliteration: wa yamliku biha aljazila min nawalika

lines.english: In return, he hid his sadness,
concealed his grief,
swallowed the pang,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَتَخَطَّ مَا مَثَّلَ لَهُ وَحْيُكَ
lines.english: and never did he violate the instructions of Your Revelation.
lines.transliteration: wa lam yatakhatta ma maththala lahu wahyuka

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ صَلاةً تَرْضَاهَا لَهُمْ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon him and his Household—blessings that You please for them,
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `alayhi wa `ala ahli baytihi salatan tardaha lahum

lines.english: and convey our abundant greetings and compliments to him,
lines.transliteration: wa balligh-hum minna tahiyyatan kathiratan wa salaman

lines.arabic: وَآتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي مُوَالاَتِهِمْ فَضْلاً وَإِحْسَاناً
lines.english: and give us - from You on account of our loyalty to them - favors, kindness,
lines.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi muwalatihim fadlan wa ihsanan

lines.english: mercy, and forgiveness.
Verily, You are the Lord of great favor.
O Allah, You have said to Your Prophet Muhammad—
may Allah bless him and his Household:
“And had they, when they were unjust to themselves,
come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah
and the Messenger had (also) asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning (to mercy), Merciful.”

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ احْضُرْ زَمَانَ رَسُولِكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
lines.english: I was not present at the age of Your Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household.
lines.transliteration: wa lam ahdur zamana rasulika `alayhi wa alihi alssalamu

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَقَدْ زُرْتُهُ رَاغِباً تَائِباً مِنْ سَيِّءِ عَمَلِي
lines.english: O Allah, I have visited him desiring, repenting from my ill deeds,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa qad zurtuhu raghiban ta'iban min sayyi'i `amali

lines.english: imploring forgiveness of my sins,

lines.arabic: وَمُقِرّاً لَكَ بِهَا وَانْتَ اعْلَمُ بِهَا مِنِّي
lines.english: confessing of my having committed these sins although You know them more than I do,
lines.transliteration: wa muqirran laka biha wa anta a`lamu biha minni

lines.english: and turning my face towards You in the name of Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy—
lines.transliteration: wa mutawajjihan ilayka binabiyyika nabiyyi alrrahmati

lines.english: may Your blessings be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: فَٱجْعَلْنِي ٱللَّهُمَّ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً
lines.english: O Allah, in the name of Muhammad and his Household, (please do) make me illustrious
lines.transliteration: faj`alni allahumma bimuhammadin wa ahli baytihi `indaka wajihan

lines.english: in this world as well as the Next World and one of those brought near to You.
lines.transliteration: fi alddunya wal-akhirati wa min almuqarrabina

lines.english: O Muhammad!
O Messenger of Allah!
May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you!
O Prophet of Allah!
O chief of all created beings of Allah!

lines.arabic: إِنِّي اتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
lines.english: In Your name do I turn my face towards Allah, my and your Lord,
lines.transliteration: inni atawajjahu bika ila allahi rabbika wa rabbi

lines.english: so that He may forgive my sins,
accept my deeds,
and settle my requests.

lines.arabic: فَكُنْ لِي شَفِيعاً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
lines.english: Therefore, be my interceder before your and my Lord,
lines.transliteration: fakun li shafi`an `inda rabbika wa rabbi

lines.english: for my Lord, the Master, is the best besought
and You are the best interceder.
O Muhammad!
May peace be upon you and upon your Household.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَاوْجِبْ لِي مِنْكَ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةَ وَٱلرَّحْمَةَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) confer upon me with forgiveness, mercy,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa awjib li minka almaghfirata walrrahmata

lines.english: and sustenance that is outgoing, good, and beneficial from Your Presence

lines.arabic: كَمَا اوْجَبْتَ لِمَنْ اتَىٰ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّداً
lines.english: in the same way as You conferred upon him who came to Your Prophet, Muhammad, when he was alive,
lines.transliteration: kama awjabta liman ata nabiyyaka muhammadan

lines.english: may your blessings be upon him and his Household,
and confessed of his sins.
lines.transliteration: wa huwa hayyun fa'aqarra lahu bidhunubihi

lines.english: Thus, Your Messenger prayed You to forgive him.
May your blessings be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا ارْحَمَ ٱلرَّاحِمِينَ
lines.english: And You did forgive him out of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
lines.transliteration: faghafarta lahu birahmatika ya arhama alrrahimina

lines.english: O Allah, I now put my hope in You, please You,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa qad ammaltuka wa rajawtuka

lines.english: stand before You,
desire for You other than anyone else,
and hope for Your abundant reward
while I confess of my sins and I do not deny them,
I repent to You from whatever I have committed,
and I seek refuge with You from this position
against the deeds that I have committed

lines.arabic: ٱلَّتِي تَقَدَّمْتَ إِلَيَّ فِيهَا وَنَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهَا
lines.english: although You, firstly, had introduced them to me as prohibited, warned me against committing them,
lines.transliteration: allati taqaddamta ilayya fiha wa nahaytani `anha

lines.english: and threatened me with Your punishment if I would violate.
And I seek shelter with the nobility of Your Face
lest You impose upon me the situation of disgrace and humility
on the day when the veils will be exposed,
the secrets and scandals will be disclosed,
and the muscles will writhe with fear;
on the day of regret and remorse,
the day of exposing the liars,
the day of the approaching doom,
the day of assembling,
the day of separation,
the day of punishment,

lines.arabic: يَوْماً كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ الْفَ سَنَةٍ
lines.english: the day the measure of which is fifty thousand years,
lines.transliteration: yawman kana miqdaruhu khamsina alfa sanatin

lines.english: the day of the blowing,
the day on which the quaking land shall quake
followed by oft-repeated commotions,
the day of raising the dead,
the day of exposition before the Fire,
the day when all mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds,
the day when a man flees from his brother,
his mother, his father,
his wife, and his children,
the day when the earth and the sides of the heavens will split asunder,
lines.transliteration: yawma tashaqqaqu al-ardu wa aknafu alssama'i

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ تَاتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهَا
lines.english: the day when every soul will come pleading for itself,
lines.transliteration: yawma ta'ti kullu nafsin tujadilu `an nafsiha

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوٱ
lines.english: the day when they will be relegated to Allah Who will inform them of what they did,
lines.transliteration: yawma yuradduna ila allahi fayunabbi'uhum bima `amilu

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلَىٰ عَنْ مَوْلَىٰ شَيْئاً
lines.english: the day when a friend can in naught avail his friend
lines.transliteration: yawma la yughni mawlan `an mawlan shay'an

lines.english: nor can they be helped
save him on whom Allah will have mercy.
Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful,

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَالِمِ ٱلغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَادَةِ
lines.english: the day when they will be returned to the Knower of the invisible and the visible,

lines.arabic: يَوْمَ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ اللَّهِ مَوْلاهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ
lines.english: the day when they will be restored to Allah, their Lord, the Just,
lines.transliteration: yawma yuradduna ila allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi

lines.english: the day when they come forth from the graves in haste,
as racing to a goal
and as locusts spreading abroad,
hastening toward the Summoner—
to Allah,
the day of the event inevitable
when the earth will be shaken with a shock,
the day when the sky will become as molten copper
and the hills become as flakes of wool
and no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend,
the day of the witness and that whereunto he bears testimony,
and they day when the angels will come rank on rank.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱرْحَمْ مَوْقِفِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ بِمَوْقِفِي فِي هٰذَا ٱليَوْمِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) have mercy upon my situation on that day (when I will be stopped for interrogation) for my current situation,
lines.transliteration: allahumma irham mawqifi fi dhalika alyawmi bimawqifi fi hadha alyawmi

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تُخْزِنِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱلْمَوْقِفِ بِمَا جَنَيْتُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي
lines.english: and do not confound me at that situation for the wrongdoings that I have committed against myself.
lines.transliteration: wa la tukhzini fi dhalika almawqifi bima janaytu `ala nafsi

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ يَا رَبِّ فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ مَعَ اوْلِيَائِكَ مُنْطَلَقِي
lines.english: O my Lord, (please do) group me, on that day, with Your intimate servants,
lines.transliteration: waj`al ya rabbi fi dhalika alyawmi ma`a awliya'ika muntalaqi

lines.arabic: وَفِي زُمْرَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَحْشَرِي
lines.english: include me with the company of Muhammad and his Household—peace be upon them—
lines.transliteration: wa fi zumrati muhammadin wa ahli baytihi `alayhimu alssalamu mahshari

lines.english: make the Pond of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet) to be my arrival point,
make me a place among the honorable, white-forehead group,
and give me my Record (of deeds) in my right hand
so that I will succeed due to my rewards,
You will make my face white,
You will make easy for me my reckoning,
You will make my pan of the Scale (of deeds) outweigh,
and I will join the triumphant ones
among Your righteous servants
to Your Pleasure and gardens of Paradise.
O God of the Worlds!

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ انْ تَفْضَحَنِي فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ
lines.english: O Allah, I do seek Your protection lest You may expose me on that day
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min an tafdahani fi dhalika alyawmi

lines.english: in the presence of Your creatures because of my sins,

lines.arabic: او اَنْ الْقَىٰ ٱلْخِزْيَ وَٱلنَّدَامَةَ بِخَطِيئَتِي
lines.english: or I may encounter disgrace and regret due to my wrongdoings,
lines.transliteration: aw an alqa alkhizya walnnadamata bikhati'ati

lines.arabic: اوْ انْ تُظْهِرَ فِيهِ سَيِّئَاتِي عَلَىٰ حَسَنَاتِي
lines.english: or You may make my evildoings outweigh my good deeds,
lines.transliteration: aw an tuzhira fihi sayyi'ati `ala hasanati

lines.arabic: اوْ انْ تُنَوِّهَ بَيْنَ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ بِٱسْمِي
lines.english: or You may declare my name as loser amongst Your creatures.
lines.transliteration: aw an tunawwiha bayna alkhala'iqi bismi

lines.english: O All-generous, O All-generous,
(I beg You for) pardon, (I beg You for) pardon,
(I beg You for) covering (my evildoings), (I beg You for) covering (my evildoings).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَاعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ انْ يَكُونَ فِي ذٰلِكَ ٱليَوْمِ
lines.english: O Allah, I also seek Your protection against including me, on that day,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa a`udhu bika min an yakuna fi dhalika alyawmi

lines.english: with the line of the evils
or add me to the row of the wretched ones.
When You shall distinguish between Your creatures
and drive each group –according to their deeds-
to their final abodes in groups,
(please do) line me up, in the name of Your mercy, with the group of Your righteous servants,
and drive me with the group of the Your pious, intimate servants
to the gardens of Your Paradise, O Lord of the Worlds!
Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O conveyor of good tidings (to the believers) and warner (against Allah’s chastisement).
Peace be upon you, O light-giving torch.

lines.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلسَّفِيرُ بَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O intercessor between Allah and His creatures.
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha alssafiru bayna allahi wa bayna khalqihi

lines.arabic: اشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ انَّكَ كُنْتَ نُوراً فِي ٱلاصْلاَبِ ٱلشَّامِخَةِ
lines.english: I bear witness, O Messenger of Allah, that You were light in the lofty loins
lines.transliteration: ashhadu ya rasula allahi annaka kunta nuran fi al-aslabi alshshamikhati

lines.english: and purified wombs.
The ignorance could not stain you with its impurities
or dress you its gloomy garbs.
lines.transliteration: wa lam tulbiska min mudlahimmati thiyabiha

lines.arabic: وَاَشْهَدُ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ انِّي مُؤْمِنٌ بِكَ
lines.english: I also bear witness, O Messenger of Allah, that I have faith in you
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu ya rasula allahi anni mu'minun bika

lines.english: and in the Imams from your Household,
and I believe in all that which you have brought,
satisfactorily and faithfully.

lines.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِكَ اعْلامُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.english: And I bear witness that the Imams from your Household are the signs of (true) guidance,
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu ann al-a'immata min ahli baytika a`lamu alhuda

lines.english: the Firmest Handle,
and the arguments against the inhabitants in this world.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ نَبِيِّكَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) do not make it the last of my pilgrimage to (the tomb of) Your Prophet—
lines.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati nabiyyika

lines.english: peace be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ تَوَفَّيْتَنِي فَإِنِّي اشْهَدُ فِي مَمَاتِي
lines.english: If you decide to grasp my soul, I will bear witness in my death,
lines.transliteration: wa in tawaffaytani fa'inni ashhadu fi mamati

lines.arabic: عَلَىٰ مَا اشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِ فِي حَيَاتِي
lines.english: as same as I have born witness in my lifetime,

lines.arabic: انَّكَ انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
lines.english: that Your are verily Allah; there is no god save You,
lines.transliteration: annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta

lines.english: alone without having any associate,
that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger,

lines.arabic: وَانَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِهِ اوْلِيَاؤُكَ وَانْصَارُكَ
lines.english: and that the Imams from his Household are Your intimate servants, Your supporters,
lines.transliteration: wa anna al-a'immata min ahli baytihi awliya'uka wa ansaruka

lines.english: Your Arguments against Your creatures,
Your representatives amongst Your servants,
Your signs in Your lands,
the custodians of Your knowledge,
the keepers of Your secret,
and the interpreters of Your Revelation.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: and convey to the souls of Your Prophet, Muhammad, and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa balligh ruha nabiyyika muhammadin wa alihi

lines.arabic: فِي سَاعَتِي هٰذِهِ وَفِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ
lines.english: at this very hour as well as all times,
lines.transliteration: fi sa`ati hadhihi wa fi kulli sa`atin

lines.english: greetings and compliments from me.

lines.arabic: وَٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.english: O Messenger of Allah, peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka ya rasula allahi wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu

lines.arabic: لاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ تَسْلِيمِي عَلَيْكَ
lines.english: Allah may not decide this compliment of me to be the last.
O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad
as he bore Your revelations
and conveyed Your messages.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as he declared lawful that which You deemed lawful,
forbade that which You deemed unlawful,
and taught Your Book (to people).
And (please) bless Muhammad
as he performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
and called to Your religion.
And (please) bless Muhammad
for he gave credence to Your promise
and feared Your threat.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, forgave sins,
concealed defects,
and relieved agonies.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, warded off misery,
relieved grievances,
responded to prayers,
and saved from misfortunes.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, had mercy on the servants,
restored lands into life,
trashed the tyrants,
and obliterated the despots.
And (please) bless Muhammad
as You, for his sake, multiplied fortunes,
protected against terrors,
broke the idols,
and had mercy upon the human beings.
